1 Scientific Literature.Title: Evaluation of Fracture Growth in BOF Slag During Steam Aging Using X-ray µCT
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: Yusuke Kato, Hiromu Yano, Kenichiro Inoue, Rinya Masuko
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Track void/crack growth in laboratory-melted decarburization slag with 0.35-12.56% f-CaO during steam aging by µCT, plus expansion tests and plant slag evaluation, to shorten steam aging for road-base use.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Slag with ~2% f-CaO showed no void increase after 24 h steam; ≥6% f-CaO showed void growth within 12 h and ≥9% marked increase in ~20 µm voids; particles disintegrate when voids reach 200-300 µm. Only 7.4% of plant particles have f-CaO ≥6%, so removing high-f-CaO particles could shorten steam aging.
